tool_args.rationale: The five observations and pilot signatures are consistent with smooth, monotone behavior but do not resolve whether the response includes a conjunctive/open-branch effect. The targeted open-branch probe is the least-cost relevant discriminator.

considered_alternatives.option: author a smooth stationary model from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The rows vary only in u_now and s_grad; other inputs and H are fixed, leaving plausible input-interaction mechanisms difficult to distinguish at the requested forecast horizon.
Costlier than the open-branch probe; current evidence does not show high-frequency oscillation or otherwise require fine temporal resolution.
It is explicitly nuisance data and is not needed to distinguish the target mechanisms.
